stem: Corrigan Robotics' lead engineer opens an editor and writes new `.tf` files describing a set of resources; nothing on the AWS account has changed yet. Which stage of the core workflow are they in?
rationale: Authoring configuration in an editor, before anything is previewed or provisioned, is the write stage. Apply is the stage that actually changes real infrastructure. Plan only previews changes; nothing has been previewed yet here. Initializing the working directory prepares providers and a backend, which is a separate concern from authoring configuration.
